Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to place this card as the bottom digivolution card, and then play a specified card?
If this card doesn't have digivolution cards, can I activate its [Main] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can be activated. After activation, you place this card under the Digi-Egg cards, then you can play a specified card. However, if the top card is now a card that doesn't have DP, it will then be trashed by rule checks.
Card Q&A.q: This card only has Digi-Egg cards in its digivolution cards. Can I activate this card's [Main] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can be activated. After activation, you place this card under the digivolution cards, then you can play a specified card. However, if the top card's DP is now 0, it will then be deleted by rule checks.
Card Q&A.q: This card only has a card with 1000 DP in its digivolution cards. If another effect reduces the DP by 1000, can I activate this card's [Main] effect?

Effect: [Main] [Once Per Turn] By placing this Digimon's top stacked card as its bottom digivolution card, you may play 1 [Agumon] or [Nokia Shiramine] from your hand with the play cost reduced by 2.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Gabumon] in name or w/[CS] trait: Cost 2
